businesses.name: 🚆 Train Prague → Kraków
businesses.can_change: seat choice, drink from the steward, printed/digital "reading for the journey", a note from the steward
businesses.limits: no expensive gifts, timetable and carriage are fixed

touches.touch: Table seat with a socket in a quiet carriage, away from the doors
signals: S1: 7 h on the train, he will probably work

touches.touch: Steward offers coffee right after Ostrava, where most people's journey "breaks"
Cipher on the napkin: the coffee comes with a card holding a short cipher. The answer is a Kraków tip ("Plac Nowy, zapiekanka after midnight")
Top of the digital "reading for the journey": an article on Kraków's game-dev scene (one of the hubs of Polish studios, e.g. Bloober Team)
Short note from the operator: "In 7 hours you could build a game, they say. Good luck with Groundbound!"

businesses.name: 🏨 Hotel in Kazimierz
businesses.can_change: room choice, welcome card, reception tips, breakfast time and form, partner bike rental
businesses.limits: room standard stays, no rebuilding the room for a guest

touches.touch: Room with a proper desk and chair, higher floor, facing the courtyard

Handwritten welcome card with 3 tips, not a brochure: (1) Kościuszko Mound at sunrise, on clear mornings you can see the Tatras, (2) the cycle path along the Vistula to Tyniec Abbey, about 12 km and flat, (3) Plac Nowy in the evening
Reception offers a breakfast to go on Friday morning if the guest mentions the sunrise
Discount at the partner bike rental, with a pannier and a phone mount available
Note on the card: "best panorama spot: the rooftop / Town Hall Tower"
If the booking includes a dog: room near the lift to the park, a bowl and a map of dog zones
Slip with the no-fly zones over the centre and the DroneRadar app, "in case you brought a drone"

businesses.name: 🗺️ Old Town tour
businesses.can_change: emphasis and order of stops, the stories the guide tells, pace, closing tip
businesses.limits: route and price stay, the group is shared

touches.touch: At the Wawel Dragon, tells the legend as Kraków's first hack: the cobbler's apprentice Skuba stuffed a sheep with sulphur. Then shows how the bronze dragon's gas burner works
More time at the astronomical instruments in Collegium Maius and Copernicus, who studied there
On the Rynek: "Stand in the middle, this is where the best 360° shot is, I'll hold the camera"
Instead of a generic "enjoy the city", one tip: Nowa Huta as a socialist urban-planning experiment (for an engineer and a Cities: Skylines player)
View south from Wawel: "On clear days you can see the Tatras on the horizon from here"

businesses.name: 🍽️ Lunch at the restaurant
businesses.can_change: table, dish recommendation, a small tasting on the house, a tip for the evening
businesses.limits: menu is fixed, care budget about €2–3

touches.touch: Window table with a view, not by the kitchen
The waiter recommends a highlander dish and brings a free taste of oscypek with cranberries with the coffee: "Smoked sheep cheese from the Tatras, in case you ever head there"
With the bill, a card with an evening tip: open mic / jam in Kazimierz
If he comes with the dog: a terrace seat and a bowl of water without asking
Thank-you on the receipt: "Enjoy your meal, and good luck with the next build"
